title: Overdrive live coach: the answer to an end
description: The answer to POST /v1/live/sessions/{id}/end (200, spec §12.1, ADR 0038): status is ended (this request ended it) or already-ended (it had ended before: the app's own end, a newer session, or the service's timeout, which is a session with no snapshot for 10 minutes); cues is how many cues the session made, which the service stored on the ride. A session the service has never heard of, or has long forgotten, is 404 not_found.
